name: Abomination, World Ravager
oracle_text:
Menace, trample
Mayhem {4}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for {4}{R} if you discarded it this turn. Timing rules still apply.)

needs.what: a card-level alternative cost, castable from the graveyard for the printed mayhem price, offered only while this card is in the graveyard because its owner discarded it this turn (a per-card 'discarded this turn' mark that clears at end of turn); the card goes wherever it normally would on resolution (a permanent to the battlefield, no exile rider)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `graveyard_cost` is an alternative graveyard price but is offered unconditionally, with no condition slot; the `cast_from_graveyard` static takes a condition but casts at the printed price ({7}{R}), not {4}{R}; and no condition or static condition key reads whether this card was discarded this turn (only aggregate values like cards_to_graveyard_this_turn). `madness` is the nearest discard-keyed cost but triggers on the discard itself and casts from exile
